title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-tkjl: shared_vectors.rs prints vector.name instead of vector.description in test log
description:
## Bug: Wrong field printed in shared_vectors test output

**File:** `rust/lichen-schc/tests/shared_vectors.rs:143`

**Severity:** P4 — cosmetic

```rust
// Before (correct):
vector.description,
// After (wrong):
vector.name,
```

The log line `Vector '{}' ({}; rule {})...` is meant to show the description, not repeat the name.
